goals: Verify that getDedupedArticleReplies handles undefined search results by returning an empty array.
Verify that getDedupedArticleReplies correctly formats article replies, deduplicates them, and filters out existing reply IDs.
activities: Call getDedupedArticleReplies with undefined search results and an empty array of existing reply IDs
Assert that the result matches an empty array snapshot
Initialize a mock search result object containing edges with various article replies
Initialize an array of existing reply IDs to be filtered out
Call getDedupedArticleReplies with the mock search result and existing reply IDs
Assert that the result matches the expected snapshot containing only deduplicated replies that are not in the existing reply IDs
